title: What to look for in your team
heading: What did you need to do?
caption: Build three skills in each person, which fix the four failures from the board, and give them an organisation designed around the goal.

the-answer.title: The answer
the-answer.script: So what did you need to do? You needed three skills in your people, and each one is tied to the failures it would have fixed.

break-down.title: Break down
break-down.script: The first is to break the work down from the goal. Do that, and the drinking drivers and the cold guests have an owner before the party starts.

write-contracts.title: Write contracts
write-contracts.script: The second is to write the contract at the seam, what a task receives, what it delivers and how it is checked. Do that, and the egg dishes cannot happen.

review-twice.title: Review twice
review-twice.script: The third is to review twice, against the contract and against the goal. Do that, and the paintball does not go ahead.

the-organisation.title: The organisation
the-organisation.script: The organisation has its own part: clear goals, contracts between teams, a policy on how much oversight each task gets, and workflows designed around the goal and not around the org chart.

look-at-your-team.title: Look at your team
look-at-your-team.script: Now look at your team. Who can break work down, who writes a clear handoff, and who can review an agent's result? Those are the skills to build, and in my view they are where your effort pays off first.

take-one-process.title: Take one process
take-one-process.script: And before Monday, do the smallest version of all of this. Pick one recurring process in your team, mark which steps an agent could run, and decide for each whether a person stays in, on or out of the loop.
